section.title: Stopping the engine in Idle STOP mode

li.p: Decrease the vehicle speed to less than 5 km/h (3 mph).
For vehicles with Manual Transmission, the vehicle must reach at least 8 km/h (5 mph) since the last idle stop.
For vehicles with an Dual Clutch Transmission/Intelligent Variable Transmission, the vehicle must reach at least 5 km/h (3 mph) since the last idle stop.
If the driver’s seat belt is unfastened or the driver’s door/hood is opened, the ISG system will be deactivated.
The ISG system will also operate when the vehicle is equipped with Smart Cruise Control (SCC) and the operating conditions are met.
